faq.q: What should I say when I lose?
faq.a: Try: Well played, or: Good game, that was close! Shaking hands or a high five shows you are a good sport.
asks: Tell me about the Good sport
What do you say after losing?

faq.q: What do I do when I feel angry about losing?
faq.a: Take a slow breath, count to five, and remember it is just one game. You can tell a grown-up how you feel later. Feeling cross is okay; hurting people or things is not.
asks: Why do I get so upset when I lose?

faq.q: How do I win without bragging?
faq.a: Say thank you, tell the other team they played well, and celebrate without teasing. Imagine how you would want a winner to treat you.
asks: Is it okay to celebrate winning?

faq.a: A sore sport, or sore loser, sulks, blames others or quits when they lose. It spoils the fun for everyone.
asks: Tell me about the Sore sport

faq.q: Why does being a good sport matter?
faq.a: People enjoy playing with good sports, so you get invited again. It also helps you learn and improve instead of giving up.
asks: Why should I shake hands after a game?

facts: At the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, held in 2021, high jumpers Mutaz Barshim of Qatar and Gianmarco Tamberi of Italy agreed to share the gold medal.
Many football matches end with players shaking hands, and FIFA gives a Fair Play award for good sportsmanship.

quiz.say: Your team just lost. Which is being a good sport?
quiz.why: Saying well played shows respect and keeps the game friendly.

wrong.0: Blaming without proof spoils the fun.
wrong.2: Throwing things is a sore-sport move and can hurt someone.

quiz.say: You won! What is the kindest way to celebrate?

options.show: Say thanks and "Good game" to them
options.say: Say thanks and "Good game" to them

quiz.why: Celebrating while respecting the other team is winning kindly.

wrong.0: Teasing makes the other team feel worse.
